title: A Lightweight Homogeneity Monitor: Prototype Dashboard for Concentration Risk

original_idea.body:
# A Lightweight Homogeneity Monitor: Prototype Dashboard for Concentration Risk

**Problem:** Open problems call for monitoring systemic/concentration risk across deployed systems, but no simple runnable tool exists for a non-lab researcher to quantify how homogeneous a set of models is.

**Direction:** Build a small open-source harness: given a prompt set and model endpoints, it outputs a homogeneity report (pairwise CAPA, embedding-similarity matrix, dendrogram, single 'monoculture index'). Validate by reproducing the Hivemind ordering.

**Why it matters:** Strategically valuable infrastructure any auditor or regulator can run without lab access - serving the EU-AI-Act systemic-risk monitoring need.

**Relevant context:** EU AI Act systemic risk monitoring; CAPA (arXiv:2502.04313); Hill-Shannon diversity (arXiv:2510.04226).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: reusable monitoring infrastructure for concentration/systemic risk serving auditors/regulators is an independently valuable deliverable on a recognized pathway.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Engineering a harness around existing metrics (CAPA, embeddings, dendrogram); accessible, mostly integration.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused tool deliverable validated by reproducing Hivemind ordering; a few components.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected, strategically valuable auditing infrastructure runnable without any lab access; serves third-party/regulatory scrutiny.

novelty.reasoning: Metrics exist; packaging into a reusable monoculture-monitor tool is partly open engineering.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Underlying metrics exist; an integrated open monitoring tool appears not yet built.
